title: Apopemptic
summary: APOPEMP'TIC, adjective [Gr. from, and a nerve.] Denoting a song or hymn among the ancients, sung or addressed to a stranger, on his departure from a place to his own country. It may be used as a noun

inlines.v: APOPEMP'TIC, adjective [Gr. from, and a nerve.] Denoting a song or hymn among the ancients, sung or addressed to a stranger, on his departure from a place to his own country. It may be used as a noun for the hymn.
